## Historical audit — S0116

**Source:** `/srv/lab-disks/disk2/users/xymo/Documents/Codex/2026-11-02/scene-rsi-rsi-1-3d-blender/outputs/scene_rsi_pilot/results/r2/sceneevolve_cli/C1/test/commons_163096530/trajectory.jsonl`. Citations below refer to this file. Only chunk 3 of 3 is visible; the image pixels themselves are not visible to this audit.

| Evidence | Observation and limit |
|---|---|
| Goal: student `model_request`, line 22, chars [0,244815) | The explicit task was an editable, multi-mesh reconstruction of one indoor RGB photograph, matching viewpoint, framing, objects, colors and occlusions. The student’s “historic dormitory” interpretation is its own inferred scene description, not independently verified reference content. |
| Construction: student programs embedded in line 22, chars [0,244815) | Code creates room architecture, three bunk assets, wardrobe, fireplace, heater, bucket and clock. Bunk posts, rails, ladders and bedding are grouped as separate parts; grouping and coordinates show intended connections, not verified physical contact. Materials include differentiated colors, metallic settings and procedural wood noise/bump. Beds are placed in upright room coordinates; no human pose is represented. |
| Autonomous revision: student programs and render feedback embedded in line 22, chars [0,244815) | After step 1, the student diagnosed bunk framing and dark materials, then changed placements, camera/lens, lighting and materials. After step 2, it claimed the rear junction was about 15 pixels low, the lintel too low and near bunk too narrow; step 3 lowered camera aim, raised the fireplace and widened/shortened bunk components. These are student diagnoses, not measured audit findings. |
| Validation: harness feedback embedded in line 22, chars [0,244815) | Steps 1, 2 and 3 each report `ok: true`, completed renders and saved Blender scenes. Thus execution and render generation succeeded; visual fidelity, part contact, texture appearance, pose, camera and lighting quality remain unverified here. No visible technical interruption or failed build is reported. |
| Final selection: student `codex_session`, line 23, chars [0,4303); `model_response`, line 24, chars [0,348); `select`, line 25, chars [0,59) | The final read-only session received paths for the reference and three renders, with tools disabled; the student answered `SELECT 3`, and the select event records step 3. Selection establishes the chosen build, not that it was geometrically or visually best. |

**Teacher input and adoption:** No teacher message is visible in this chunk. The system’s reconstruction procedure and harness comparison prompts are visible instructions, not evidence of teacher feedback or its adoption. Earlier chunks are unavailable, so teacher involvement elsewhere is unknown.

**Outcome and lessons:** Formal build/render success and an explicit selection are observed; reconstruction correctness is **unknown**, not independently established partial or full visual correctness. The revisions illustrate a transferable distinction between global camera adjustment and local geometry/material changes, but their effectiveness is unresolved. Bunk widths, fireplace height and the claimed pixel discrepancy are task-specific hypotheses. The reported successful renders do not resolve whether objects intersect correctly, whether the foreground occlusion matches, or whether lighting and textures resemble the photograph.
